data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence of sites and goal and covers nearly all the parameters, but it is vaguer in places: it omits the 8+ review score filter, the Viator price, and the restaurant time, and it hardcodes the 19:30 time. It also merges the two activities into one list parameter, never states that the Notes and Mail text must follow the exact templates, and says "send or discard" where the true workflow requires Discard and never Send, so an automation built from it alone would likely behave inexactly.
